The ECD store contract's conformance vectors (version 1, status proposed), copied unchanged:

  outcomes.tsv   the outcomes of a write: 13 cases, 34 steps, 10 columns     (contract: outcomes, idempotency)
  rows.tsv       class, open, feed and recovery rows: 22 checks, 6 columns,
                 16 required and 6 deferred                                 (contract: conformance)

TestOutcomeVectors runs every step of outcomes.tsv through the adapter and fails unless all 34 were checked.
TestRowsMapping maps each check of rows.tsv whose status is "required" to a named test of this package and fails
when a required check has none or a mapped check is not in the file. Deferred checks stay unmapped.

A step's fault is injected like this: io-at-commit by a test-only hook on the commit path (the COMMIT happens and
then fails, or the transaction rolls back and then fails: both landings are exercised); full-rolled-back by
PRAGMA max_page_count with the table filled to its page limit; space-freed by raising max_page_count again;
full-open by the commit hook, which leaves the transaction open with SQLITE_FULL; busy by a second connection that
holds a write lock past busy_timeout.
